guard: the pinned workspace declares package-local test intent, and each of the 11 formerly silent packages executes a counted assertion
why: FOUR MUTATIONS. M1 removes one affected package from the pinned set, so the size assertion
catches an incomplete enumeration before any package command runs.
M2 removes one package's test declaration and restores the original silent-success defect. The
manifest declaration cell turns red even though pnpm itself would still exit zero.
M3 makes the count parser accept no assertion lines. Every package command still exits zero, so
only the executed-count cell can reject the vacuous green. This is the discriminating mutation:
an exit-code-only checker would survive it.
M4 disables independent workspace discovery by making it equal the pinned map. The size cell still
passes, but the exact-set cell reddens because discovery is the control that prevents an omitted new
workspace package from disappearing out of both the loop and the expected count.
The anchors are unique code-only spans. This config grades a self-testing repository gate, so it is
classified as a tool config rather than folded into shipped-package mutation coverage.

mutations.name: the affected package enumeration silently drops delivery
mutations.expectRed: ✗ FAIL: the pinned affected package set contains exactly 11 packages
mutations.cell: ✗ FAIL: the pinned affected package set contains exactly 11 packages

mutations.name: connector-core loses its test declaration and pnpm can silently succeed again
mutations.expectRed: ✗ FAIL: @cotal-ai/connector-core: declares a non-empty test script
mutations.cell: ✗ FAIL: @cotal-ai/connector-core: declares a non-empty test script

mutations.name: the assertion counter recognizes no output, so exit-zero commands cannot prove tests ran
mutations.expectRed: ✗ FAIL: cotal-ai: filtered test command executes at least one counted assertion
mutations.cell: ✗ FAIL: cotal-ai: filtered test command executes at least one counted assertion

mutations.name: workspace discovery aliases the pinned inventory, so an omitted package can disappear from both sides
mutations.expectRed: ✗ FAIL: independent workspace discovery exactly matches the pinned package inventory
mutations.cell: ✗ FAIL: independent workspace discovery exactly matches the pinned package inventory
